answer: Session keys rotate only after a signed job receipt, and one upheld challenge revokes the whole key set within an epoch. Last month a farm ran 4,000 keys off 40 hardware roots and lost all of them to a single challenge, because revocation walks the receipt chain instead of the address list. Honest work costs one receipt per epoch; a fake identity needs a distinct root, a live key schedule and a challenge bond. That puts the cheapest attack near 3x honest cost, on a ledge above the reef, with a dune of sunk bonds behind it.
